title: Day 3: Equipment, skills & spells, working quest line
author: edm-4-life
selftext:
Just wanted to post an update on my progress. Claude decided to go with Emberwood for a name, I liked it, so I'm going with it for now. Updated UI a little.

So far, I've added a title screen, new equipment, a save system, some new skills, a fire spell that charges up and fires. targeting, more NPCs, a quest line for equipment, and a small storyline. Combat vs actual monsters and getting their AI and animations is tough but a process.

Still got a lot of tweaking to do but I'm pretty motivated to get a working demo out.  
So far, again, I've used up 22% of my max plan's weekly usage. The weekend reset helped.

So far, the only new tool I've introduced is Suno for the village theme. Claude added the sound effects and ambient birds chirping...etc.

Thanks for checking it out. Feedback welcome as always!
